info.title: Acuven Inventory Shop Service API
info.description: Unimplemented design contract. No public server is configured. Set the validated deployment base URL explicitly. Document version 1.0 is separate from API version.

x-authorization: HTTP bearer with application-enforced connection/environment/object/action scope checks; not OAuth scopes.

get.summary: Read own connection, scopes and verified capabilities
get.description: Design contract only; not implemented. Connection and environment are derived from authenticated service identity. Every referenced object is authorization checked. Tenant, pool, location, Core instance and module authorization are verified server-side. Quantity writes delegate to the unique Core ledger.

serviceBearer.description: Opaque server-held credential; connection/environment bound. Never send in URLs or expose in browser.

sku_id.description: Stable variant ID from the shared product identity catalog, authorized for this tenant/pool/connection.

shared_stock_enabled.description: Verified module authorization for shared sales in this pool; returned by the service, not caller selected.

x-quantity-authority: Shared stock ledger Core; Inventory wraps atomic commands and does not own another quantity ledger.
